reason: 基于仓库说明和清单，插件的主要用户面向用途是为 DSH 聊天输入场景提供一键文本/提示词润色服务：点击按钮后对草稿进行改写并回填输入框。它通过可配置的外部模型服务与本地规则回退链实现功能，属于通用工具类的文本处理插件，非代码生成、研究、媒体处理或协作工具。

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DSH 聊天输入框增加一键润色按钮，可快速改写用户的提示词草稿或文本，并支持在设置中切换模型服务与回退策略。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a one-click polish button to the DSH chat input to rewrite drafted prompts or text, with configurable backend providers and fallback strategy options.

capabilities: Rewrites user draft text in the DSH chat input via a single click
Calls external AI endpoints through configurable model providers
Supports fallback to shared proxy, local model endpoints, and local rule-based polishing
Provides plugin settings API endpoints for config read/save/test operations
Reads/writes plugin configuration including API credential fields

reasons.code: README states a DSH input Sparkle button reads draft text and writes back rewritten content.
README documents supported providers and a four-stage fallback chain for the optimize path.
package.json exposes DSH client injection and plugin bundle configuration indicating in-app UI route integration.
Tree includes lib/index.js, client/client.js, config files, tools, and worker, indicating host-side routing, UI injection, and proxy/model-access code paths.
